stories.title: Drew Lock has another limited practice but does not have an injury designation
stories.summary: Drew Lock was limited in practice Friday, his sixth consecutive practice without team drills.
stories.detail: Drew Lock was limited in practice Friday, his sixth consecutive practice without team drills. Like last week, though, Lock will play through oblique and elbow injuries. Lock does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders. "He had a similar cadence and workload in terms of last week," Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Friday, via John Boyle of the team website. "It's good to have done it and gotten through the week well. I know he's confident and optimistic, so we're in good shape." The Seahawks ruled out starter Sam Darnold (ribs/quad) for another week, but he would return after the Week 11 bye. Offensive guard Quenton Nelson (knee), offensive tackle Charles Cross (ankle) and defensive tackle Leonard Williams (stinger) also won't play. The Seahawks are getting back outside linebacker Uchenna Nwosu, receiver Rashid Shaheed and nose tackle Brandon Pili. All three were full participants Friday and do not have an injury designation.

stories.title: 49ers-Cowboys preview: Christian McCaffrey and the Niners should run wild
stories.summary: What to expect when the 49ers have the ball, and why the defense likely only needs a few stops against the Cowboys
stories.detail: (Photo by Ezra Shaw/Getty Images) | Getty Images History will lead you in the right direction more often than not. The head-to-head matchups between the San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys have been one-sided. It’s why it’s a rivalry in name only. How the 49ers have fared against the NFC East and the Cowboys versus the NFC West is more evidence of what to expect this coming Sunday. The Niners have been terrific in that regard, while Dallas has gone 2-5 in their previous seven games — including a loss to the Jacoby Brissett and Gardner Minshew-led Cardinals, in a game in which they allowed 30 points. Let’s preview Week 10’s matchup to see whether Dak Prescott can keep pace with Brock Purdy. What to expect when the 49ers have the ball Purdy is 3-0 in his career against the Cowboys. His fourth start against Dallas might be the biggest mismatch, at least on this side of the ball, to date. The 49ers are top-three offensively in points per game, EPA per pass, EPA per rush, passing and rushing success rate, and in third-down and red-zone efficiency. stories.title: Cowboys aggressiveness on offense must be turned up vs. 49ers
stories.summary: What do the upset-minded Cowboys need to do at home to beat the 49ers?
stories.detail: Photo by Stacy Revere/Getty Images | Getty Images After two straight weeks of early window kickoffs in which the Dallas Cowboys had to fight, claw, scratch, and get knocked down to go 1-1 against the Arizona Cardinals and Indianapolis Colts, they play in the Sunday late afternoon window against the San Francisco 49ers. Both teams are off a win, which puts the Cowboys right back in a position they’ve been time and time again and failed in nearly every time, trying to win consecutive games under Brian Schottenheimer. The Cowboys can’t afford to spin their wheels much longer if they want to make this season mean something though. This 49ers matchup is exactly that opportunity for the Cowboys, so let’s get to how they can pull off the upset. The Dallas Cowboys will beat the San Francisco 49ers if… …they win on 1st down on both offense and defense. Think for a second about how many NFL offenses are truly earning the label of “elite”, “scary”, or “explosive” right now, then without looking at any other metrics or analytics consider the top four tiers in the first downs per play category. stories.summary: Never boring, this team of ours.
stories.detail: MINNEAPOLIS, MN - SEPTEMBER 13: Kirk Cousins #8 of the Minnesota Vikings passes the ball in the second quarter of the game against the Green Bay Packers at U.S. Bank Stadium on September 13, 2020 in Minneapolis, Minnesota. (Photo by Stephen Maturen/Getty Images) | Getty Images Kirk Cousins is once again the quarterback for the Minnesota Vikings. Welcome to the most exciting, if anxiety-riddled, stretch of Vikings football in memory. The next few months will be unlike any other. General manager Nolan Teasley did what he had to do. A 3rd-round pick was a small price to pay to avoid the iceberg. After an embarrassing, mind-boggling, inept offensive showing in front of the entire nation on Monday Night Football that threatened a full-on locker room mutiny and the season’s implosion, the ship has now been steered into calmer waters. Whether it will be there when the calendar turns to January is still very much up in the air. The only situations even remotely comparable were Sam Bradford’s arrival days before the 2016 season and Randy Moss’ return in 2010. stories.title: 49ers OT Williams, LB Greenlaw questionable, WR Evans out vs. Cowboys
stories.summary: The 49ers are listing left tackle Trent Williams and linebacker Dre Greenlaw as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, while receiver Mike Evans has been ruled out.
stories.detail: SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- The San Francisco 49ers had two important additions to their injury report this week with left tackle Trent Williams (shoulder) and linebacker Dre Greenlaw (knee) now listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys . According to coach Kyle Shanahan, Williams and Greenlaw suffered their injuries in Thursday's practice, with both players listed as limited for that day because of it. Greenlaw was again limited Friday, while Williams did not practice. "Anytime you hurt your shoulder on a Thursday, it doesn't make you totally at ease," Shanahan said of Williams. "Sunday comes fast, but hopefully that's enough time for him to be all right." If Williams is unable to play, the Niners will turn to swing tackle Vederian Lowe to step into the lineup. And if Greenlaw can't play, rookie Jaden Dugger will move into the weakside linebacker spot, according to Shanahan. "Hopefully we'll have Dre on Sunday, but if we don't, next man up, and our next man's proven himself so far," Shanahan said. Elsewhere on the injury report, wide receiver Mike Evans (Achilles) will miss his third straight game. He's the only Niner officially ruled out against the Cowboys …

teamStories.summary: QB Drew Lock will start again for Darnold. LB Uchenna Nwosu and WR Rashid Shaheed will return to the field in Las Vegas.
teamStories.detail: RENTON, Wash. - Seattle Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Drew Lock had a good week of practice as he prepares to fill in again for Sam Darnold on Sunday against the 4-5 Las Vegas Raiders (4:05 p.m. ET, CBS) -- this time despite a pair of ailments of his own. Lock was already dealing with an injury to his right elbow when he hurt his oblique last Sunday in Seattle's 17-3 win over the Arizona Cardinals . He was again limited in practice all week, as has been the case since the start of Week 6. "Similar cadence in workload in terms of last week," Macdonald said Friday. "It's good to have done it and gotten through the week well. I know he's confident and optimistic, so we're in good shape." In addition to Darnold (quad, rib) and left guard Quenton Nelson (knee) -- whom Macdonald had ruled out earlier in the week -- the Seahawks will be without defensive tackle Leonard Williams (stinger) and left tackle Charles Cross (ankle) again Sunday. They'll get outside linebacker Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) and wide receiver/kick returner Rashid Shaheed (knee) back against the Raiders after each missed the past two games. Defensive tackle Jarran Reed will play Sunday after missing two days this week…

stories.title: Lakers' Austin Reaves day-to-day with bruised heel, doesn't undergo imaging
stories.summary: The Lakers appear to have avoided serious fallout from an injury-riddled game.
stories.detail: Any Los Angeles Lakers game in which Luka Dončić and Austin Reaves both exit with injuries is going to be concerning, but it appears the team has dodged any serious fallout. Two days after the Lakers’ two leading scorers left a win over the Milwaukee Bucks , head coach JJ Redick told reporters Friday that he expects Dončić to be available for Sunday’s game against the Phoenix Suns. Dončić had already told reporters he was “good” the night of the injury, which was a tweaked ankle. As for Reaves, Redick said the guard was day-to-day with a bruise on his heel, but the matter is apparently minor enough the team didn’t even bother with imaging on the foot. “AR, based on his physical evaluation and how he was feeling yesterday, we opted against imaging. He’ll be day-to-day. We’ll have him on the report tomorrow at 5 o’clock.“ Even with their early exits Friday, no pair of teammates is averaging more com,bined points per game than Dončić and Reaves. Dončić leads the league in scoring with 38.6 points per game, while Reaves if 15th with 24.7. Dončić is also ninth in the league in assists per game at 7.6. stories.title: Lakers' Austin Reaves day-to-day with left heel bruise
stories.summary: Lakers guard Austin Reaves is considered day-to-day as he deals with a left heel bruise, coach JJ Redick said Friday.
stories.detail: EL SEGUNDO, Calif. -- Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves is considered day-to-day as he deals with a left heel bruise, coach JJ Redick said after practice Friday. Reaves left L.A.'s 123-112 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday midway through the third quarter and did not return after landing awkwardly on his left foot after missing a contested fast-break dunk. Reaves underwent X-rays at the arena Wednesday that came back clean. After seeing how Reaves was feeling Thursday morning once the Lakers returned to Los Angeles, the team determined that further medical imaging on the shooting guard's foot would not be necessary. When Redick was asked if Reaves had suffered only a "minor" injury, considering the Lakers decided to forgo an MRI, the coach replied: "I would assume a day-to-day injury is minor, yeah." Redick provided injury updates on three other Lakers players as well. Luka Doncic , who turned his right ankle late in the win over the Bucks, "is fine," according to Redick. "I think the expectation would be he's available," Redick said, referring to L.A.'s next game against the Phoenix Suns on Sunday. Redick said backup guard Collin Sexton , who required stitches ab…

stories.title: Dejounte Murray wants trade from Pelicans; both sides working on resolution
stories.summary: Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray wants a trade from the franchise, and his agent, Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul, and team officials have started working on a resolution.
stories.detail: New Orleans Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray wants a trade from the franchise, and his agent, Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul, and team officials have started working on a resolution. "Today, Dejounte Murray's representatives informed us of his request to be traded," the Pelicans said in a statement Friday. "We will evaluate potential trade opportunities that are in the best interest of our organization." Murray has made it clear to the organization that he is ready to play a key role in meaningful basketball elsewhere, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania. The Pelicans are 4-8 to start the season and have lost four games in a row, including a 145-111 blowout at home to the Brooklyn Nets on Wednesday. Murray has been ruled out because of a left ankle sprain for Friday night's NBA Cup game against the Memphis Grizzlies . After the latest game, Murray tweeted a response to an account that noted that the Pelicans are 3-0 without Murray in the lineup and 1-8 with him on the court: "From what's going on INSIDE, this sounds like someone hit you to say this! teamStories.detail: December 17, 2020; Sacramento, California, USA; Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry (left) dribbles the basketball against Sacramento Kings guard De'Aaron Fox (right) during the first quarter at Golden 1 Center. Mandatory Credit: Kyle Terada-USA TODAY Sports The Golden State Warriors are facing perhaps their largest challenge of the season tonight: a road game against Victor Wembanyama and the defending Western Conference champion San Antonio Spurs, without Steph Curry. This won’t be easy. Here’s the full injury report for both teams: Warriors Out — Steph Curry (right oblique tear) Curry was injured early in Wednesday’s game against the Houston Rockets, and will be re-evaluated in two weeks . Needless to say, that’s a huge hit for the team, and now begins the quest of trying to tread water with Curry sidelined. Out — Brandon Williams (left hamstring strain) That aforementioned task is a little bit harder because the team is missing one of their top bench scorers in Williams, who was injured during Monday’s victory over the New Orleans Pelicans.
